messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — multiple nodes in us-west-2 reporting paged-kv allocator fragmentation >85% and OOM kills. auto-scale attempted, fallback to spare pool failed for 3 containers. alert-id=inc-1775009876 :rotating_light:

maya.oncall: seeing it, pulling logs now. priority: mitigate live customer impact.

sam.sre: confirming CUDA driver errors in the crash logs: `CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_FAILED` and then `SIGKILL (OOM)`. nodes: rwi-infer-usw2-03..05.

lee.runtime: heap / paged-allocator map shows many small resident pages pinned by KV cache. likely slow fragment creep. pagemap stats: `frag_ratio=0.87, resident=64GB, free_slices=3%`.

maya.oncall: customer impact?

anita-support: getting reports — AcmeCRM and two smaller customers seeing 500s on inference endpoints in us-west-2. Support ticket numbers incoming, communicating P1.

maya.oncall: immediate action: 1) disable paged-attn allocator on affected nodes, 2) trigger `kv_cache_compact --force` on live pool, 3) rolling-restart node group with `--drain` off to avoid long tail. will also enable fallback-model routing to reduce load to hosted fallback.

sam.sre: commands I'm running now:
```bash
ssh rwi-infer-usw2-03 sudo systemctl stop redwood-serving
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv_cache_compact --force --timeout 120
sudo systemctl start redwood-serving
```

lee.runtime: if `kv_cache_compact` fails we should temporarily set `RWI_ALLOC_PAGE_LIMIT=256MB` on containers to force early eviction. preparing a small env-patch.

ops-bot: deploybot: triggered restart of rwi-infer-usw2-03..05 (rolling). change set: runtime: disable_paged_attn=true, env: RWI_ALLOC_PAGE_LIMIT=256MB.

maya.oncall: noted. Sam — paste exact error excerpt you saw.

sam.sre: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T01:23:11Z] model-server[pid=2387]: attention_pager: page_alloc failed: cannot find contiguous slab
[2026-03-17T01:23:11Z] model-server[pid=2387]: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_FAILED at attention_cuda.cu:412
[2026-03-17T01:23:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2387 (model-server) total-vm:512000kB
```

anita-support: I've opened a P1 with AcmeCRM and flagged they are in slot `us-west-2a`. SLA-monitor shows error spike 01:22-01:40 UTC. letting customers know we're mitigating, will follow up once stable.

maya.oncall: mitigation progress: compaction succeeded on 03 and 04, restarted services. 05 hit compaction timeout, I escalated to forced restart. routing fallback reduced traffic by ~40% to eu fallback.

lee.runtime: monitoring mem metrics — fragmentation down to 0.62 on 03/04, 05 still 0.88 but restarting. KV cache reclaim rate is low, may need allocator fix.

sam.sre: creating short-lived emergency build to add a conservative alloc coalescer and lower max slab split. patch branch: `hotfix/alloc-coalesce-177500` — will run quick canary on 03 after restart.

maya.oncall: support — please send templated update: short blurb, we mitigated by restarting nodes and reducing fragmentation; engineering patch in progress; ETA for full stabilization 2h.

anita-support: sending now.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary deploy of hotfix to rwi-infer-usw2-03 succeeded, no regressions in 5m.

lee.runtime: canary metrics look good: no OOMs in 10m, fragmentation trending down after compact and coalescer.

maya.oncall: next steps — keep hotfix canary for 30m, then roll to 04 and 05. if any node shows fragmentation >0.75 after roll, drain and reprovision. assign RCA owner.

sam.sre: assigning RCA to @sam.sre and @lee.runtime. timeline and postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/incidents/1775009876 (will update).

anita-support: customers notified, will open follow-up case for AcmeCRM with mitigation notes and ask for spike logs.

maya.oncall: handing off to night oncall @lee.runtime in 30m. leaving runbook notes in thread and escalation checklist. :thumbsup:

lee.runtime: acknowledged — I'll continue monitoring and start the full roll once hotfix window passes. leaving contact details in incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident 1775009876 status update: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced, severity -> SEV2 -> monitoring. next update ETA +30m.
